pages.text: Once a pattern makes sense, you can follow it with a chisel. $(l)Place a blank core, blank node or clay ball on the carving desk.$() Choose a pattern you know, then carve.

pages.title: Vessels and Impressions
pages.text: Gems become spell cores and nodes. Clay becomes a hardened rune plate.$(br2)Set a plate into the wall of a device, and aether can follow the pattern carved across its surface.
